notes: BUU v3.1.6 - stuck-run fix. Root cause of runs that never shut down: a browser dialog (alert/confirm, or a "leave page" beforeunload) froze a worker, and because the pool waits for every worker to exit, one frozen worker hung the whole run for hours. Two fixes: (1) BUU now always closes every dialog as a fallback - registering any dialog listener silently disabled the browsers auto-dismiss, which is why unhandled dialogs hung; (2) a worker watchdog force-kills any worker that goes silent for 4 minutes, returns its rows to the queue, and lets the pool finish. Also adds a license readout showing in-use / total / free. Includes all 3.1.4-3.1.5 fixes (license cap, verified logout, buffer floor, updater launch, journals never auto-deleted).
